Title: Ocean's Nut

In the deep sea's embrace,
A whale sings to the walnut tree,
Roots entwined in grace.

Below the tranquil, blue waves.
Above, walnut tree sways.

Through ocean's vast, endless sky.

The tree remains, always.

Ocean's nut, they say,
A tale of two worlds intertwined.
Their love will never sway.
